tasks.instruction_text: Book a flight with KLM from Lagos, Nigeria to Frankfurt, Germany flying out 07/17/2026 and coming back 07/25/2026. Make sure the destination autocomplete resolves to Frankfurt am Main (FRA) — not Frankfurt-Hahn (HHN) — and the calendar advances to July 2026 to set both depart and return dates.
Same Lagos → Frankfurt KLM booking but for a one-week trip: Aug 14, 2026 → Aug 21, 2026. Watch the dropdown — Frankfurt am Main (FRA) is what you want, not Florø (FRO) or Hahn (HHN).
Book a KLM flight Lagos → Frankfurt for Feb 26, 2027 returning Mar 5, 2027 — the calendar opens on May 2026 so you'll need to advance about 9 months. Confirm destination resolves to FRA.
One-way KLM flight Lagos → Frankfurt (FRA) on Oct 22, 2026. No return needed — just set destination FRA and pick Oct 22, 2026.
What's the cheapest KLM fare shown for Lagos → Frankfurt on Sep 9, 2026? Reply in $X form (e.g. $985).
On the LOS → FRA results for Jul 17, 2026, how many KLM options are there (i.e. operated by KLM, not Lufthansa or Ryanair)? Reply with the integer (e.g. '2 KLM flights').
What's the flight duration for KL 591 Lagos → Frankfurt? Answer in the format '7h 50m' in quotes.
Configure the search: destination Frankfurt am Main (FRA), depart Jul 17, 2026, return Jul 25, 2026. Then report how many KLM options exist for that route+date (e.g. '2 flights').
Set the search Lagos → Frankfurt for Jan 15, 2027 → Jan 22, 2027. Then report the KLM flight number for that depart in quotes (e.g. "KL 573").
Configure: destination FRA, depart Apr 30, 2027, return May 7, 2027 (the calendar will need to advance ~12 months). Report the price of that KLM service in $X form.
